subject: [PATCH v7 0/6] fuse: add io-uring buffer pools and zero-copy

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch series adds support for io-uring buffer pools and zero-copy to the FUSE file system, allowing servers to pass in a contiguous chunk of memory that the kernel can use to service requests. This reduces memory usage requirements and enables optimizations for assigning payload memory to requests. Additionally, it introduces zero-copy functionality, which allows direct access to client pages or page cache folios without copying data through an intermediary buffer, requiring CAP_SYS_ADMIN privileges and using buffer pools.
